value.test: income-tax on total income < MAT on book profit

rules.extract: the book profit shall be deemed to be the total income of that assessee for such tax year; and (ii) the assessee shall be liable to pay income-tax equal to the minimum alternate tax.

rules.desc: MAT does not apply to companies that opted for s.200 or s.201 (or life-insurance business)
rules.extract: (ii) who has exercised the option under section 200(5) or section 201(2).

value.eligible: domestic company that exercised option u/s 200(5) or 201(2) for a tax year beginning on/after 1-4-2026
value.carry_forward_limit: 15th tax year after the year the credit first became allowable under s.115JAA

rules.display: Set-off in any year capped at 25% of tax payable on total income under the other provisions; balance carried forward; 15-year outer limit. Not available under the normal (MAT) regime.
rules.extract: such credit brought forward shall be allowed to be set off in any tax year to the extent of 25% of the tax payable on the total income computed as per the other provisions of this Act for that tax year

rules.desc: Book profit — statutory additions and reductions (v1: book profit is a user input; adjustments listed on the note page)
rules.extract: "book profit" means the profit as shown in the statement of profit and loss for the relevant tax year prepared as per clause (f), as increased by—

rules.desc: Inter-corporate dividend deduction (allowed under normal regime and under ss.200/201)

value.deduction: dividend received from domestic company / foreign company / business trust, limited to dividend distributed at least one month before the s.263(1) due date

rules.extract: as does not exceed the amount of dividend distributed by it at least one month before the due date for filing the return of income under section 263(1).

rules.desc: Buy-back — Finance Act 2026: consideration is no longer 'dividend' (s.2(40)(f) omitted); taxed as capital gains in the shareholder's hands

value.treatment: capital gains = consideration − cost of acquisition, in the year of buy-back

rules.extract: the difference between the cost of acquisition and the value of consideration so received shall be deemed to be the "Capital gains" arising to such shareholder

rules.desc: Buy-back — additional income-tax where the shareholder is a promoter (buy-back u/s 68 Companies Act)

rules.display: Additional tax on promoter: STCG 2% (domestic co.) / 10% (others); LTCG 9.5% / 17.5%; plus 12% surcharge on tax charged u/s 69
rules.extract: 1. Short-term capital gains referred to in section 196 arising from the transfer of such securities. 2% 10% 2. Long-term capital gains referred to in section 197 or section 198 … 9.5% 17.5%

rules.desc: NOTE (Private vs Public): deemed dividend on loans/advances applies only to a company in which the public are NOT substantially interested
rules.extract: any payment by a company, not being a company in which the public are substantially interested, of any sum … as an advance or loan to a shareholder … holding not less than 10% of the voting power

rules.desc: NOTE (Private vs Public): closely-held company — carry-forward of losses lost on change in shareholding unless 51% voting power continuity
rules.extract: shares of the company carrying not less than 51% of the voting power were beneficially held by the persons who beneficially held shares of the company carrying not less than 51% of the voting power on the last day of the year or years in which the loss was incurred

rules.desc: Special-rate incomes for companies (ss.194, 196, 197, 198) at the same rates; s.198 exemption 1,25,000 applies; no shortfall adjustment; no rebate

rules.display: 30% on specified income + applicable rate on taxable regular income and residual income (which rate for a Section 8 company? — OPEN_QUESTIONS Q16)
rules.extract: (a) at the rate of 30% on specified income for such tax year; and (b) at the rate applicable on taxable regular income and any residual income for such tax year under other provisions of this Act.

value: income from property/deposits/investments held for charitable or religious purposes
rules.extract: (d) voluntary contributions received by such registered non-profit organisation in such tax year

rules.desc: Taxable regular income — 85% rule

value.formula: if (applied + accumulated) ≥ 85% of regular income → nil; else 85% of regular income − applied − accumulated

rules.extract: (a) nil, where 85% or more of the regular income of such tax year has been applied … or accumulated … (b) in any other case, 85% of the regular income for such tax year as reduced by its application … or accumulation

rules.desc: Deemed accumulation of 15% of regular income
rules.extract: to the extent of 15% of regular income, shall be considered as deemed accumulated income

rules.desc: Application of income — donation to another registered NPO counts at 85%; corpus donation to another NPO not application; no application out of corpus/loan/accumulation
rules.extract: (b) 85% of the sum paid by way of donation made to any other registered non-profit organisation.

rules.desc: Deemed application (shortfall option) — to be applied in the year of receipt/next year, option by s.263(1) due date
rules.extract: the shortfall, or any part thereof, at the option of the registered non-profit organisation, may be treated as deemed application.
